_meta.author: Hand-authored for ScrollProof feasibility v2 (not model-generated). Domain: Bengaluru small-business inventory / dispatch coordinator.
_meta.notes: prereqs are direct prerequisites only; closure is computed in code. Diagnostic items carry deterministic numeric answers.

percent_basic.label: Percentages: meaning and percent of a quantity

unit_conversion.label: Units and pack sizes (kg, dozen, carton)

sheet_navigation.label: Spreadsheet cells, rows, columns, cell references

order_reconciliation.label: Reconciling orders vs invoices vs deliveries

inventory_reconciliation.label: Reconciling recorded stock vs physical count

add_sub.q: You had 240 packets. 85 were dispatched and 30 returned. How many packets now?

mult_div.q: A carton holds 24 bottles. How many bottles in 15 cartons?

percent_basic.q: 48 out of 60 orders were on time. What percent were on time?

percent_change.q: Price went from 250 to 300. What is the percent increase?

commission_calc.q: Commission is 2% of order value. Orders worth 12,500 today. Commission?

read_table.q: Table: Mon 40, Tue 35, Wed 50 orders. Which day had the most orders? Answer with the count.

sheet_navigation.q: In a spreadsheet, the cell in column C and row 7 is called C7. Which column number is C? (A=1)

sheet_formulas_basic.q: A1=120, A2=80, A3=50. What does =SUM(A1:A3) return?

sheet_percent_formula.q: B2 holds 800 (order value), C2 holds 5 (percent). What does =B2*C2/100 return?

pct_add_instead_of_multiply.label: Adds the percent number instead of multiplying (15% of 400 -> 415)

pct_divide_by_percent.label: Divides by the percent instead of multiplying by pct/100 (15% of 400 -> 26.67)

pct_change_wrong_base.label: Uses the new value as the base for percent change (250->300 gives 16.67)

pct_points_vs_percent.label: Confuses percentage points with percent change

sheet_percent_no_divide.label: Forgets /100 when the cell holds a whole percent (=B2*C2 -> 4000)
